lines.text: 你知道「复仇女神」是什么意思吗？由合适的代理人体现出来的、正义的报应。就眼下这情形，代理人是个可怕的混蛋：我。
lines.en: Do you know what 'nemesis' means? A righteous infliction of retribution manifested by an appropriate agent. Personified in this case by an 'orrible cunt: me.
